instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot shows a bright office interior next to large windows. On the left, the woman in the striped blazer (R1) sits on a gold wire chair, profile facing right, gesturing with her right hand while holding a white coffee cup. Opposite her on the right, the man in the floral short-sleeve shirt (R2) sits on a matching chair, profile facing left, listening with his hands in his lap. They are positioned across a small round marble table, engaged in a casual conversation. Natural light streams from the windows behind them, creating a bright, neutral-toned atmosphere with a soft, shallow depth of field.
elements: R1 gestures with her right hand while R2 listens with his hands in his lap
R1 holds the white coffee cup rather than R2
R2 is the listener facing R1 while R1 is the gesturing speaker
